title: Monotonicity of the halting bound
statement: Let $A$ be a nondeterministic register program, with fixed oracle, input, and predicate $G$. If every choice word of length $N$ from a configuration $a$ leads to a halted configuration and all earlier nonhalted configurations satisfy $G$, then the same holds for every choice word of length $N'$ whenever $N\le N'$.
hypotheses_covered: A nondeterministic register program $A$, oracle, input, and predicate $G$
A configuration $a$ and natural numbers $N,N'$ with $N\le N'$
Every run from $a$ on a choice word of length $N$ halts and has $G$ at every earlier nonhalted configuration
